definition: Sora is a text-to-video model and social media app developed by OpenAI.
details: Using artificial intelligence, the model generated short video clips based on prompts, and could also extend existing short videos. In February 2024, OpenAI previewed examples of its output to the public, with the first generation of Sora released publicly for ChatGPT Plus and ChatGPT Pro users in the United States and Canada in December 2024. The second generation of Sora was released to select users in the US and Canada at the end of September 2025. Sora 2 integrated social media features into the app. The app was shut down on April 26, 2026 and the application programming interface (API) is planned to be discontinued on September 24, 2026, marking the end of the Sora AI brand as a whole. By default, the generator used copyrighted material in its videos, unless copyright holders actively opt out of having their content included. Videos contained a visible, moving digital watermark to prevent misuse, but a week after Sora 2's release, third-party programs became available which could remove the watermark.

explainer.lead: Sora is OpenAI's text-to-video model and social media app that generates short video clips from prompts and can extend existing short videos. It brought AI video generation to public ChatGPT users.

tiers.eli5: You type a description and Sora makes a short video of it, and later versions added social media features like an app.
tiers.practitioner: Use it to turn prompts into short clips or to extend existing short videos. Keep track of which generation you target, since access and features differ between Sora 1 and Sora 2.
tiers.paperLevel: Described as a text-to-video model: it maps a text prompt to a short generated video and can extend existing short videos. No formal definition or evaluation bound is given.

explainer.example: OpenAI previewed example outputs publicly in February 2024, then released the first generation to ChatGPT Plus and Pro users in the US and Canada in December 2024.
